---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new capability
title: "feat: <short description>"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who is affected, and when does it come up?
A clear "I'm trying to do X but Y gets in the way" framing is ideal.

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you would like to see. Be as specific as you can — UI sketches,
API shape, config keys, or pseudocode all help.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why is the proposal above preferred?

## Additional context

- Related issues or PRs
- Links to similar features in other tools
- Screenshots, diagrams, or data points
- Whether you'd be willing to implement this yourself
